# OISTNB

OISTNB is a retro dark theme with a warm orange glow and a pitch-black titlebar. It adds subtle CRT flicker and is styled dark-only, which the recorded description presents as a vintage, high-contrast writing atmosphere.

![OISTNB screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omsandippatil/OISTNB/HEAD/OISTNB.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "OISTNB"
    author: "omsandippatil"
    repo:   "omsandippatil/OISTNB"
    slug:   "oistnb"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/oistnb"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/omsandippatil/OISTNB"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omsandippatil/OISTNB/HEAD/OISTNB.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a retro dark Obsidian theme with a warm orange glow and a pitch-black titlebar. Add subtle CRT flicker and strict dark-only styling for a vintage, high-contrast writing atmosphere."
}
```
